item_verdicts.manifest: read; its commit a75752c5, its five changed paths, both cohort arms with counts and log paths, the declared mutation, measurement_module/measurement_cwd and the follow-on all match the files I opened, and my own recheck at the reviewed head reproduces 6 passed for the new file in 3.95s and the one added failure in the same run.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence is reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_promotion_refuses_a_base_commit.py, the landed evidence html, the figures directory for this plan and the plan html; git diff --name-status f64f60ee a75752c5 lists exactly those five paths and --numstat shows every one as pure addition, so both cumulative records were spliced rather than rewritten.

justifications.evidence: both cohort logs match my own arms (tests/test_promotion_refuses_a_base_commit.py is 4 failed / 2 passed at f64f60ee and 6 passed at a75752c5, and the added failure reproduced in my head run) and the mutation log's first line repeats the declared string verbatim, but the done_when's zero-added-failures clause is unmet by tests/test_crew_promotion.py::test_complete_manifest_with_changed_paths_and_commit_promotes at :670.
justifications.fit: the helpers follow the module's existing probe idiom (subprocess.run with check=False, as at reckon/crew/promotion.py:351), add no name the naming rules forbid, and the new test file is ruff-format clean, but two hunks in the change's own lines, reckon/crew/promotion.py:236 and :313, are what ruff format --check would rewrite while ruff check holds at 10 findings on both the base and the head copy.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:287 refuses the citation that resolves to the base, :296 refuses one the base is not an ancestor of, and :320 refuses the commitless promotion holding the run's declared work, all before the write; the normal citation path is untouched by tests/test_promotion_refuses_a_base_commit.py:225, which passes on both arms.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat f64f60ee a75752c5 lists the five declared paths and nothing else, every line an addition, the plan's version and modified meta lines are untouched, and the failing test's file is left clean.
